title: PLM Developer
summary: PLM developers customise product lifecycle management (PLM) software, the systems engineering companies use to manage parts, drawings, bills of materials and design changes. They sit in PLM or engineering IT teams, often at IT services firms, and work with design engineers and ERP teams.
dailyDuties: Write server-side customisations and workflow handlers
Add data model changes such as new item types and properties
Build integrations between PLM, CAD and ERP systems
Customise PLM web client screens and reports
Fix production issues raised by engineering users
Meet engineers to understand change and BOM processes

skills.expectation: Customise one major PLM platform with its server APIs, data model tools and UI framework
Customise one major PLM platform with its server APIs, data model tools and UI framework
Write Java code for PLM server extensions, clients and integrations
Query the PLM database to check and fix data
Build and call REST or SOA services to connect PLM with other systems
Turn engineering change and BOM processes into technical designs
Explain designs and changes to engineering users
Write Teamcenter ITK code in C or C++
Customise web clients such as Active Workspace
Work with XML and SOAP-based PLM interfaces
Integrate PLM with SAP through BAPIs or IDocs
Manage customisation code in version control

certifications.why: Teamcenter postings name Siemens certification as a plus.
